text:
Ravi Shah: starting RC creation for payments-ingest change. artifact: `payments-ingest:2026-03-21-rc2` - need pin and quick sign-off.
Maya Li: noted. I updated the release notes and added the rollback steps (short). link: https://internal.docs/releases/payments-ingest/2026-03-21
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] request received -> candidate job queued (id: 11421).
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] candidate build complete: payments-ingest:2026-03-21-rc2 (sha: a1b2c3d)
Ravi Shah: running integration smoke against staging now, will post results.
Maya Li: staging smoke looked ok earlier but we saw a tiny spike in retry counts on high load. keeping an eye.
Sheriff Dana: oncall standby for promo window. recommend canary 3% then 20%.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promoting to canary (3%) -> promo-11421-canary
OpsBot: [opsbot] canary telemetry snapshot: p95 220ms (baseline 200ms), errors 0.08%
Maya Li: p95 is slightly higher, but errors are within normal. are retries the same?
Ravi Shah: retry rate up 40% vs baseline on canary. looks correlated to client backoff logic. investigating.
Maya Li: hmm. we added a new batching optimization that might change upstream pacing.
Sheriff Dana: hold on ramp. don't increase traffic until retries stabilized.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promo paused by manual hold (Sheriff Dana)
Ravi Shah: rolling back canary to 0% for now and re-evaluating.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] rolling back canary -> promo-11421-canary -> rollback initiated
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] rollback complete: traffic restored to previous stable artifact payments-ingest:2026-03-08-stable
Maya Li: created a quick patch to reduce batching window, pushing hotfix candidate: payments-ingest:2026-03-21-rc2-hotfix (sha: f9e8d7c)
Ravi Shah: can we do a targeted progressive promo only to internal traffic (team_qa) to validate the hotfix?
Sheriff Dana: yes, internal route only. I authorize controlled promo.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promoting to internal_qa (5%) -> promo-11421-internal
OpsBot: [opsbot] internal telemetry: p95 198ms, retries back to baseline, no error surge
Maya Li: looks good on internal. requesting ramp to 20% limited to non-critical regions (us-west2, eu-west1).
Sheriff Dana: approve. keep abort thresholds: p95 > 25% regression or retries > 25%
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] ramping to 20% -> promo-11421-stage1
OpsBot: [opsbot] stage telemetry: p95 203ms, retries +5% (within threshold)
Ravi Shah: proceeding to full ramp to 100% over 12 minutes with staged increases.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promoting to 100% -> promo-11421-final
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promotion complete: payments-ingest:2026-03-21-rc2-hotfix now serving 100% (pinned)
Maya Li: post-promotion monitors green. will open a short follow-up ticket to document the batching change and add regression tests. TICKET-5089
Sheriff Dana: good catch and quick pivot. marking oncall clear.
Ravi Shah: thanks team — closing this RC thread and pinning artifact to stable. will do a brief post-deploy readout in tomorrow's standup. :thumbsup:
